items.displayTitle: DACRI: Decision-Aware Causal Intervention Ranking for Critical Supply Chains
items.title: DACRI: Decision-Aware Causal Intervention Ranking for Critical Supply Chains
items.shortSummary: DACRI studies intervention selection—not only disruption detection—in critical supply chains through a controlled synthetic benchmark with causal ground truth and an explicit net-value objective. The results identify settings in which adaptive ranking creates recoverable value under partial or delayed information, alongside settings where simpler structural policies remain preferable.
items.citationText: Shiqi Huang, Jiani He, Dingyan Shang, Yihua Xu, Jize Li, Yan Lyu, and Lashimi Muraleedharan Nair. DACRI: Decision-Aware Causal Intervention Ranking for Critical Supply Chains. arXiv:2608.11154, 2026.

items.title: A Multi-asset Transportation Infrastructure Asset Management Framework and Modeling for Local Governments
items.venue: U.S. Department of Transportation National Transportation Library
items.publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation National Transportation Library
items.shortSummary: An early public output examining transportation infrastructure asset management through a multi-asset framework and mathematical modeling for local governments.
items.abstract: Local governments manage substantial roadway and bridge networks while facing aging assets and constrained budgets. The report develops a systematic, multi-asset framework for cost-effective maintenance, rehabilitation, and reconstruction decisions, with the aim of improving budget allocation and accountability.
items.authorshipNote: Coauthored technical report; Yihua Xu is not listed as first author.
